definition: Embodied intelligence is a whole-organism property distributed across policy, sensors, routing, metabolism, action, immunity, psychological regulation, and social grounding.

layers.engineering_substrate: VLA policy, planner, world model, reasoning loop
layers.typical_failure: brain-centric overcommitment without enough sensory or provenance evidence
layers.evidence_gate: checkpoint identity, prompt/action trace, policy version, decision log

layers.engineering_substrate: camera views, tactile probes, proprioceptive state, language input
layers.typical_failure: single-view aliasing, occlusion, symbol ambiguity, missing context
layers.evidence_gate: sensor coverage, active-view trace, ambiguity set, observation hashes

layers.engineering_substrate: message passing, context routing, control pipeline, attention budget
layers.typical_failure: dropped signals, stale context, wrong module receives the evidence
layers.evidence_gate: timestamped pipeline trace, routing decision, context budget log

layers.engineering_substrate: GPU budget, battery, latency, memory, API spend, data flow
layers.typical_failure: apparently wise behavior that is too slow, too costly, or unsustainable
layers.evidence_gate: wall-clock, GPU, energy, API, memory, and storage telemetry

layers.engineering_substrate: controllers, action primitives, skill APIs, low-level servo loops
layers.typical_failure: valid plan with unstable execution, joint-limit collision, slip, or latency
layers.evidence_gate: action trace, joint state, contact state, controller version, recovery trace

layers.engineering_substrate: failure atlas, antigens, antibodies, recovery adapters
layers.typical_failure: same failure repeats because no transferable antibody was retained
layers.evidence_gate: antigen ID, antibody payload, activation condition, transfer result

layers.engineering_substrate: uncertainty calibration, refusal threshold, evidence pressure, attention control
layers.typical_failure: overconfidence, panic loops, refusal collapse, or hallucinated certainty
layers.evidence_gate: confidence trace, uncertainty estimate, evidence-pressure record, intervention log

layers.engineering_substrate: human feedback, role constraints, team protocols, norm memory
layers.typical_failure: instruction succeeds physically but violates role, norm, consent, or trust boundary
layers.evidence_gate: human instruction log, norm check, role state, approval or override provenance

layers.biological_analogy: theory of mind and strategic social cognition
layers.engineering_substrate: opponent model, recursive belief model, commitment detector, multi-agent debate
layers.typical_failure: agent treats a strategic signal as literal and misses bluff, feint, or reflexive adaptation
layers.evidence_gate: payoff model, belief-depth trace, opponent-action log, commitment evidence
